```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ent-ref "Resolved Entity Text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext-ent SYSTEM "external.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment exercising parser comment state -->
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with <tags> and &entities; inside ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&ent-ref;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY internal 'Parametric Entity Text'>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ref "&internal;">
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="afl" data="test-mode=true"?>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://example.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment 1: Before CDATA -->
  <section m:type="primary">
    <![CDATA[Some complex data with markup <script>alert(1)</script>]]>
  </section>
  <section>&ref;</section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ENTITY entity-val 'Value from Parameter Entity'>">
  %p-ent;
  <!ENTITY direct "Direct Entity">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY file-ext SYSTEM "data.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment introducing namespace and CDATA combination -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unparsed symbols: <>&'"
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&entity-val; and &direct;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department*)>
  <!ELEMENT department (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e-corp "Global Corporation">
  <!ENTITY e-branch "&e-corp; Branch Office">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-macro;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<enterprise xmlns="http://enterprise.org/ns" xmlns:hr="http://enterprise.org/ns/hr">
  <!-- HR Department comment -->
  <department hr:region="north">
    <![CDATA[
      Sensitive records: <confidential>data</confidential>
    ]]>
  </department>
  <department>&e-branch;</department>
</enterprise>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %p1;
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Archive Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY comp-ent "Composite: &base-ent;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY pdf-file SYSTEM "doc.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="dump"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Metadata comment block -->
  <record dc:title="Test Record">
    <![CDATA[
      Record data block containing literal <xml> syntax & reference-like text.
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&comp-ent;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock-item "Widget A">
  <!ENTITY stock-desc "Description for &stock-item;">
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY macro-text 'Macro Output'>">
  %ext-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="inventory.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.com/inventory" xmlns:inv="http://example.com/inventory/ns">
  <!-- Inventory tracking comment -->
  <stock inv:status="active">
    <![CDATA[
      Inventory details: <item id="1">In Stock</item>
    ]]>
  </stock>
  <stock>&stock-desc; - &macro-text;</stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (payload*)>
  <!ELEMENT payload (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % builder "<!ENTITY built-ent 'Built-in Entity Value'>">
  %builder;
  <!ENTITY final-ref "Final: &built-ent;">
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY raw-bin SYSTEM "binary.bin" NDATA bin>
]>
<?xml-log target="syslog" facility="daemon"?>
<response xmlns="http://api.example.com/v1" xmlns:res="http://api.example.com/v1/response">
  <!-- Response payload container comment -->
  <payload res:format="xml">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload payload <payload-inner>&built-ent;</payload-inner>
    ]]>
  </payload>
  <payload>&final-ref;</payload>
</response>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE library [
  <!ELEMENT library (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY b1 "Programming XML">
  <!ENTITY b2 "Advanced &b1; Techniques">
  <!ENTITY % meta-macro "<!ATTLIST book id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %meta-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="lib.css"?>
<library xmlns="http://library.org/schema" xmlns:bib="http://library.org/schema/bib">
  <!-- Library catalog entry comment -->
  <book id="bk01" bib:category="tech">
    <![CDATA[
      Book summary: <chapters><chapter>1</chapter></chapters>
    ]]>
  </book>
  <book>&b2;</book>
</library>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % setup "<!ELEMENT config (#PCDATA)>">
  %setup;
  <!ENTITY t-name "Integration Test">
  <!ENTITY t-desc "Running &t-name; suite">
  <!NOTATION exe SYSTEM "application/x-executable">
  <!ENTITY test-bin SYSTEM "test.exe" NDATA exe>
]>
<?xml-test-runner timeout="30" verbose="yes"?>
<suite xmlns="http://test.org/suite" xmlns:qa="http://test.org/suite/qa">
  <!-- QA test suite execution comment -->
  <test qa:priority="high">
    <![CDATA[
      Test logs: <status>PASSED</status> & details.
    ]]>
  </test>
  <test>&t-desc;</test>
</suite>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE payload-container [
  <!ELEMENT payload-container (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY n-primary "Primary Node Data">
  <!ENTITY n-secondary "Secondary Node Data: &n-primary;">
  <!ENTITY % entity-decl "<!ENTITY internal-macro 'Macro Expansion'>">
  %entity-decl;
]>
<?xml-custom-pi action="initialize" param="value"?>
<payload-container xmlns="http://container.org/ns" xmlns:nc="http://container.org/ns/nc">
  <!-- Container header comment block -->
  <node nc:index="0">
    <![CDATA[
      Embedded CDATA content with <markup> and &internal-macro; reference.
    ]]>
  </node>
  <node>&n-secondary;</node>
</payload-container>
```
